scenario: Monday morning: the team shares what they did over the weekend, all in past simple. Kate: 'I visited my sister and we cooked all day.' Pol: 'I tried a new smoothie bar and cycled thirty kilometres.' Alex: 'I did not sleep. Four kids, remember? We watched cartoons and built a huge blanket fort.' Den: 'I cleaned my whole flat and organised my mugs by size.' Valery grumbles happily: 'I stayed home. I did nothing, and it was perfect.' Peter, shy: 'I studied English all weekend.' Everyone smiles; it is a cosy Monday. Use a clear mix of regular and irregular past verbs (visited, cooked, tried, cycled, watched, built, cleaned, stayed, did, studied, was, were) and one or two negatives with 'did not'. Short A2 sentences.
